title: Design: the switch-location dialog as the design draws it
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has an open work order invoice {Invoice-A} made at {Location-B}.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST D-76 Design Dialog.
  • Starting screen: A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with {Customer-A} ticked and every bucket expanded.
  • The design picture "Another location asks first" (ar-ap-p5-another-location-asks-first.png) is attached to this case and open beside the browser at 100% zoom; compare the layout, labels and styles, not the names and amounts, which are only examples.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click {Invoice-A}'s number.
  2. Read the buttons, letter for letter, left to right.
  3. Look at the dialog's top right corner.
  4. Click the "×".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the "Switch location?" dialog opens over the report.
  • Step 2: "Cancel" (grey) on the left, then "Switch Location" (blue, capital L) on the right, as in the picture.
  • Step 3: a close "×".
  • Step 4: the dialog closes and you stay on the report, as with "Cancel" (option (a) of the question).

Held: this is the design's version of a difference from the PRD. Question 11 on Chris Ward's question sheet (added 22 Oct 2026) decides it. If the design wins, this case is released and the PRD-following cases change; if the PRD wins, this case is deleted with the QA lead's go-ahead.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11537 (Story 7, Document links open where they can)

  • S7-R3: “An invoice or part sale at another location the user is enrolled in shows the existing location-switch prompt on the report, before leaving it: title "Switch location?", message "This work order is in {location}. Switch your active location to view it?" (for a part sale: "This part sale is in {location}. Switch your active location to view it?"), buttons "Switch location" and "Cancel".”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Click an invoice at another enrolled location | Title "Switch location?", message "This work order is in {location}. Switch your active location to view it?" | Dialog on the report; "Switch location" switches and opens, "Cancel" stays”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 5 "Document links and Switch location" (board Links.dc.html). This held case follows the design picture below, not the PRD sentence quoted above (Rule 130 item 5): the quote shows what the PRD says today, the picture what the design shows.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p5-another-location-asks-first.png: figure "Another location asks first" (This build (after)), board "5. Document links and Switch location (SV-5706)"

The design's own words:

  • ""Switch location? This work order is in Staging Lethbridge - 4310. Switch your active location to view it?" on the report. Switch Location opens it there. S7-R3, S7-R4." (caption of "Another location asks first")

Difference from the PRD (DD-01): the PRD says buttons "Switch location" and "Cancel" (S7-R3), title "Switch location?"; the design shows buttons "Cancel" (left, grey) then "Switch Location" (right, blue, capital L), and a close "×" at the top right of the dialog; caption: "Switch Location opens it there.". This held case follows the design; the difference is question 11 on Chris Ward's question sheet (added 22 Oct 2026); the design version is this case.
